name: everlast-protocol
description: Nothing an AI session learned is lost when you change model, session, tool or vendor. Two tiers of plain-markdown knowledge: a per-project doc set (solutions with dead ends, decisions with reasons, plans, a 50-line HANDOFF, an index) committed with the repo or kept in an excluded folder when the repo cannot hold it, and a user tier in a private vault repository (profile, environments, cross-project lessons). A privacy split keeps people, politics and credentials out of any shared repo. Hooks orient each session, nudge capture once, and sync the vault at session end. Installs in Claude Code, Cowork, Copilot and anything that reads Agent Skills. Follows the Evergreen Protocol in pointer mode.
